shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui -R | head -50

head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ------; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; echo ------; cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; find src; cat src/*; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>&1

npm install @gravity-ui/uikit 2>&1 | tail -15; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; grep -A8 '"peerDependencies"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json

sed -n 170,230p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; grep -B2 -A12 peerDependenciesMeta node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput PasswordInput Checkbox Card Text ThemeProvider Flex 2>&1 | head -60

sed -n 230,262p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput PasswordInput Checkbox Card Text ThemeProvider Flex 2>&1 | head -60; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && cat build/docs/INDEX.md | head -80; ls build/docs/components build/docs/guides | head -80; grep -n -i -B2 -A25 "required setup\|## Setup\|ThemeProvider\|Provider" README.md | head -90

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs && ls components/controls; grep -n -i -A12 "Provider" guides/migration-to-v8.md | head -60; sed -n 1,200p components/controls/TextInput.md 2>/dev/null | head -120
sed -n 1,80p components/Checkbox.md; grep -n -i "view\|size\|type\|loading\|width" components/Button.md | head -40; sed -n 1,60p components/Card.md

sed -n 1,25p components/controls/PasswordInput.md; grep -n "^| " components/controls/PasswordInput.md | head -30; grep -n -i "type\b\|htmlType\|submit" components/Button.md | head; grep -n -B2 -A30 "## Flex" guides/layout.md | head -80; grep -n "variant" components/Text.md | head -8

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build && grep -rn "gap" esm/components/layout/Flex/*.d.ts esm/components/layout/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "type?" esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head; grep -n "width\|Width" esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -5; grep -rn "spacing-" docs/guides/layout.md | head -8
